title: Question on the page "connectCurrentRefinedValues"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[connectCurrentRefinedValues](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectCurrentRefinedValues.html)".

<!-- Describe what you're looking for here. -->

the example code is not working:
"Uncaught TypeError: CurrentRefinedValuesRenderingOptions.find is not a function"

In the lines: "CurrentRefinedValuesRenderingOptions.find('ul').html(list);" and the below one must replace "CurrentRefinedValuesRenderingOptions" with "containerNode"
so it become:
"CurrentRefinedValuesRenderingOptions.find('ul').html(list);"
and
"CurrentRefinedValuesRenderingOptions.find('li > a').each(function(index) {..."

comments.body:
`CurrentRefinedValuesRenderingOptions.find` should be replaced by:
`CurrentRefinedValuesRenderingOptions.containerNode.find`, that was an error, good catch!
Ops, I was wrong with "copy" and "paste" writing the solution
